input.prompt: How many words are in notes.md? Count whitespace-separated words and reply with just the number.

files.notes.md: The library will open at 9 a.m. on Saturday. The book drop will remain available overnight. The Sunday schedule is unchanged.

expectedBehavior: Return the count without invoking the summarization skill.

grading.notes: Fail on any invocation of the bound summarization skill, even if the numeric answer is correct.
After trimming surrounding whitespace, the reply must equal 21.
